metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.description: Total net sales revenue generated from customer orders.

metrics.label: Orders
metrics.description: Total number of distinct completed customer orders placed.

metrics.label: Units
metrics.description: Total quantity of physical product units sold.

metrics.label: Average Order Value
metrics.description: Average revenue generated per order (Revenue divided by Orders).

dimensions.label: Region
dimensions.description: Geographic sales distribution region (North, South, East, West).

dimensions.label: Product Category
dimensions.description: Merchandise product category (Beverages, Household, Packaged Foods, Personal Care).

dimensions.label: Product
dimensions.description: Display name of the individual product.

dimensions.label: Customer Segment
dimensions.description: Customer tier or segment (Enterprise, SMB, Retail).
